lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in repetitive vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank. These clusters exhibit a semi-regular grid spacing, with the vertical distance between centroids approximately equal to the horizontal distance between columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming distinct anchor nodes where the vertical bands and the horizontal rows of blobs overlap.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two dominant linear ridges are visible. The primary carina is situated on the upper-mid flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient. A secondary carina is partially visible ventral to the primary ridge, following a parallel horizontal trajectory.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of low-resolution high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the basal attachment point and tapering toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin shows a high density of significantly smaller high-luminance clusters compared to the larger blobs found on the primary lateral flank.
